BM25 filter keeps only pages relevant to the query

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:crawlberg/crawlberg.dart';
import 'package:crawlberg/src/crawlberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final engineConfig = await createCrawlConfigFromJson(json: r'{"bm25_query":"rust programming language","bm25_threshold":0.1,"content_filter":"bm25","max_depth":1}');
    final engine = await CrawlbergBridge.createEngine(config: engineConfig);
    final url = 'https://example.com';
    final result = await CrawlbergBridge.crawl(engine, url);
    stdout.writeln(result.pages[0].html);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
